verdict.rationale: Box documents an event feed/API (box-docs-8, box-docs-19, box-docs-39) allowing subscription to user or enterprise events, real-time or historical monitoring of actions across the enterprise, which is a documented audit-log/API-access mechanism security teams can use for SIEM export or auditing pipelines. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of a native SIEM connector or third-party SIEM integration guide, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of enterprise event log completeness or retention.
